When🌸🌽arrived, they saw☄️crouched in a corner trembling…

☄️：我會盡全力支援生病的咪口親ᕦ(ò_óˇ)ᕤ✨

2020年7月19日。

miComet成軍僅一天，咪口便因先天病的緣故開始無法正常配信。咪口在當時經過一番掙扎，中間一度試著繼續安排配信日程，無奈身體狀況不允許，最終在跟營運及家人討論過後，決定自7月31日起開始長休專心治療，連即將到來的8月1日的二週年紀念Live都必須延期。

☄️：I will support Mikochi who is sick as much as I could in every way ᕦ(ò_óˇ)ᕤ✨

July 19th, 2020.

It was just the second day since the group miComet was established, due to an illness Miko was born with, she’s started to have difficulties stream regularly. She struggled and still tried to schedule days to stream. Unfortunately her condition did not improve. Eventually after discussions with Cover managements and her family, she’s decided to go on a hiatus to recover, starting July 31st, 2020. She’s even had to postpone the upcoming second anniversary live stream that was scheduled on August 1st.
